description: This file defines a PHP class 'OutboundEmailAccountsViewEdit' that extends 'ViewEdit'. It primarily customizes the display method to assign an 'is_admin' variable based on the current user's admin status, utilized in the editing view of the outbound email account module in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: OutboundEmailAccountsViewEdit
classes.description: A PHP class extending ViewEdit to customize the display behavior for editing outbound email accounts, including assigning admin status to the view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the parent display method to set the 'is_admin' variable in the view, indicating whether the current user has admin privileges.
